description: A function-identifier as a CALL USING argument (identifier-2, BY CONTENT or keyword-less). X3.23-1985 Amendment 1 adds to the CALL statement "Identifier-2 must not be a function-identifier." (§1985:X.5.2.3 SR4; identifier-2 is the operand of both USING phrases, §1985:X.5.2.2). ISO/IEC 1989:2002 has no such rule: its Format 1 BY CONTENT identifier-2 is any identifier, and §2023:14.9.4.4 GR8 makes a sole function-identifier an identifier. Gated in the one up-front judgement of a COBOL-85 CALL's arguments, CallBinder.FunctionIdentifierArgumentOf asked from BindCall beside Format2OnlySpellingOf, so the argument draws this COBOL0900 alone (a keyword-less one is not also refused COBOL1677 by the 2023 storage-section rule). kb/Work PB5129.
